items.title: Publish Front Door managed-rule metadata in API 2026-04-01
items.summary: Adds the stable 2026-04-01 API version and versions new managed-rule response metadata, including rule-set status and display name, rule paranoia levels, and variable names. The changes propagate to ManagedRuleSets_List and policy operations without altering the existing 2025-11-01 contracts.
